method: plan exported and imported into a scratch plans root; one skeleton item per phase reading knowledge/contracts#participants; plan.py context --budget; lifecycle.design_report; then P2 narrowed to section reads with the phase bindings of architecture, type-map and target-structure removed. The real plan was not changed by the simulation.
conclusion: Every phase-bound document reaches item packs (no silent loss in scoped mode); design-done lists phase-bound documents no item reads; packs exceed the budget until bindings of the large references move to item section reads, after which a typical P2 pack is about half the budget.
